chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to me, Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Mu'min al-Ansari, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
The hand that wears a turquoise ring will never be needy.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of wearing a turquoise ring according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) stating that a hand wearing a turquoise ring will not be empty (i.e., will not fall into poverty), linking the adornment to divine sustenance. This narration reflects the Shia tradition of attributing spiritual and material barakah to specific gemstones, viewing them as means of attracting God's mercy and protection from need.
